name: Shattered Complex of the 267-Concept Cornerless Class
statement: Partition the twelve coordinates of $Y_{267}$ into three consecutive groups of four, each split into two labelled pairs. Its shattered supports are the empty set, all singletons and pairs, and exactly the 188 triples that are not transversals meeting every group once with even label parity. These triples are its facet supports, every coordinate contraction has 208 concepts, and its cube-automorphism group is trivial.
proof: Direct enumeration gives the displayed shattered complex and trivial automorphism group. Its size is $1+12+66+188=267$, agreeing with the ample class order. Each coordinate belongs to 47 admitted triples, so its full reduction has $1+11+47=59$ concepts and the contraction has $267-59=208$. Every pair extends to an admitted triple, so the 188 triples are precisely the facets and therefore support the facet cubes.
